shots.alt: The page Brickworks shows while it loads: the mark and Brickworks over a half-built wall of coloured bricks on a grey baseplate seen from a little above, 16 of 27 bricks laid under it, then a card: Tip, Press F1 for every key and click Brickworks answers to.
shots.caption: While it loads: the wall builds as the app arrives, with a tip under it.

shots.alt: The Brickworks menu open under the mark at the far left of the menu bar: About Brickworks, Send feedback, Find a command with its key Ctrl+/, Brickworks website, Documentation and Account.
shots.caption: The Brickworks menu, at the far left of the menu bar.

shots.alt: Brickworks on a phone, 390 pixels across: the mark, the model's name, undo and redo along the top, the red car on its baseplate with a note that it opened, and one row of tools along the foot.
shots.caption: On a phone: one row of tools, and the rest in sheets over the model.
